idea-plugin.name: AI Reference Copier
idea-plugin.description:
Overview

A lightweight plugin for IntelliJ Platform IDEs that copies AI-readable paths to help AI tools locate code when working alongside your IDE.

How to use

  • Copy a code location: Select code in the editor and choose “Copy AI Code Reference” from the context menu. With no selection, the current cursor line is copied.
  • Copy a file or folder: Select one file or folder in the Project view and choose “Copy AI Reference...” from the context menu.
  • Use shortcuts: Press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+R for a code reference or Ctrl+Alt+Shift+P for a file or folder reference. The shortcuts can be changed in the IDE Keymap.
  • Customize the format: Search for “AI Reference Copier” in Settings/Preferences to choose project-relative or absolute paths, edit code, file, and folder templates, and view their previews.

The default output uses paths relative to the IDE project root with / separators. The plugin does not read source contents, access the network, or call AI services.

中文说明

面向 IntelliJ Platform IDE 的轻量插件，IDE与AI工具协作时复制AI可理解的路径，提供给AI做代码定位。

操作方法

  • 复制代码位置：在编辑器中选中代码，右键选择“复制 AI 代码引用”；未选择代码时复制当前光标所在行。
  • 复制文件或文件夹：在 Project 文件树中选中一个文件或文件夹，右键选择“复制 AI 引用...”。
  • 使用快捷键：代码引用使用 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+R，文件或文件夹引用使用 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+P；可在 IDE Keymap 中修改。
  • 自定义格式：在 Settings/Preferences 中搜索“AI Reference Copier”，可选择项目相对路径或绝对路径，分别设置代码、文件和文件夹模板并查看预览。

默认输出以 IDE 项目根目录为基准的相对路径，统一使用 / 分隔符。插件不会读取代码正文、连接网络或调用 AI 服务。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.6.0

  • Adds a setting to choose project-relative paths (the new default) or absolute paths for all reference types.
  • Previews code, file, and folder references using the selected path type and custom templates.
  • Adds an ellipsis to the Project view action in both English and Simplified Chinese. The editor action keeps its existing label.

中文：新增项目相对路径与绝对路径选项，默认使用相对路径；预览同步展示代码、文件和文件夹引用；中英文文件/文件夹菜单增加省略号，代码复制菜单保持原有名称。
